rationale: The retained board's CAN buses and U6/U8 endpoints dominate remaining opens. All four CAN chokes are currently displaced far to the right of their transceivers, creating long local CANH/CANL connections through the passive field. Move L5-L8 below U5-U8. To free that row, move C50-C53 from the upper passive bank beside their corresponding U13-U16 eFuses. This changes local grouping/spacing while retaining the outline, all original component geometry, net assignments, layers, widths and vias. Native preflight must reject any new clearance issue before full routing.
